dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: The worst is over, and now... I can relax.

choices.text: Ningguang, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Thank you. Ah, just as expected — it's exquisite!

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: The fetor problem could have had grave consequences. But, thanks to you and Director Hu, we were able to resolve it without issue.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Allow me to thank you again on behalf of all Liyue Harbor.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Many in this world claim to be heroic, but it takes a true hero to step forward in times of crisis.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Liyue Harbor is truly fortunate to have received the help of so many heroes.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: ...Anyway, I won't force you to listen to my compliments any longer. I want you to actually enjoy the festivities — that includes the food, too.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: The crisis is over, so take it easy and make the most of the festival.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Goodbye. I hope you a have a relaxing Lantern Rite.
